get.summary:
An image, as WebP, for team members who uploaded it or can see an item
referencing it. Attachments never change, so it is cached as immutable.

304.description: `If-None-Match` matches the `ETag`: the cached image is current

get.summary: Returns the sign-in options.

post.summary: Signs in with a username or email and a password.

200.description: Signed in; sets the refresh cookie

post.summary: Signs out: revokes the session and clears the cookie.

204.description: Signed out; clears the refresh cookie

get.summary: Starts single sign-on: redirects to the identity provider.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Local path to open after signing in.

get.summary:
Completes single sign-on: verifies the provider's answer, signs the user
in, sets the refresh cookie and returns to the app. No token is put in the URL.

303.description: Redirect to /auth/callback, or to /login?error=… on failure

post.summary: Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token (and rotates the cookie).

200.description: Session renewed; rotates the refresh cookie

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked refresh cookie

patch.summary: Renames a group (participants, during Group; the last name saved wins).

post.summary:
Gives a group one more of the caller's votes, or takes one back
(participants, during Vote).
Not idempotent (POST): each request is one more vote, or one fewer.

200.description: The meeting, with the caller's votes

409.description: `meeting_ended`, `wrong_phase` (not Vote), `vote_budget_exhausted`, `vote_group_limit` (the most votes on one group), or `no_vote_to_remove`

get.summary: Shows an invitation to whoever holds its link.

post.summary: Accepts an invitation: the caller joins the team as a member.
Declines an invitation.
Joins the team behind an enabled join link as a member.

get.summary: Returns the signed-in user with their teams and pending invitations.

patch.summary: Changes the signed-in user's display name.

put.summary: Replaces the signed-in user's picture with the request body.

requestBody.description: A PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image of at most 5 MB

post.summary: Follows a meeting invite link: joins the team if needed, then the meeting.

404.description: `meeting_invite_invalid`: unknown, replaced, or the meeting ended

put.summary:
Makes a group the current one (facilitator, during Discuss): everyone's
room follows it.

200.description: The meeting, on its new current group

post.summary: Ends the meeting (facilitator).
Transfers the facilitator role (facilitator) or takes it over (team admin).

403.description: `not_facilitator`: neither the facilitator nor an admin taking over

post.summary:
Drops a card onto another card: groups both, or adds the card to the
target's group if it has one by now (participants, during Group).

200.description: The meeting, with the cards grouped

404.description: `meeting_not_found`, or `reflection_not_found` (not a card of this meeting)

post.summary:
Goes back to someone who already had their turn (facilitator); the turn
continues from them.

409.description: `meeting_ended`, `wrong_phase`, or `icebreaker_not_reached` (they have not had their turn yet)

post.summary: Moves the icebreaker to the next person (facilitator).

get.summary: The invite link of a running meeting (any team member).

post.summary: Replaces the invite link, invalidating the previous one (facilitator).
Joins a running meeting as a participant (idempotent).

200.description: The meeting, with the caller as a participant

post.summary: Advances to the next phase (facilitator).

put.summary: Sets the caller's own ready flag (participants, in Reflect, Group and Vote).

post.summary: Sends a reflection (participants, during Reflect).

201.description: The meeting, with the new reflection

patch.summary:
Sets the vote budget and the most votes per group (facilitator, until
Vote ends). Lower limits remove each person's most recent votes beyond
them.

200.description: The meeting, with its new settings

get.summary:
How many people these limits would take votes from, never who
(facilitator, until Vote ends): the warning of the settings dialog.

parameters.name: voteMaxPerGroup
parameters.description: Most votes one person may give the same group.

200.description: How many people would lose votes

get.summary: The meeting room's full state; used on entry and after a reconnect.

404.description: `meeting_not_found`: no such meeting or not a team member

get.summary:
The summary of an ended meeting: facts, groups by votes with their
anonymous reflections, and its tasks with their current status.

404.description: `meeting_not_found`: no such meeting or not a team member

post.summary:
Writes a task for the current group (participants, during Discuss). It
lands in the Active column of the team's board.

201.description: The meeting, with the new task

put.summary: Sets, pauses, resumes, extends or stops the timer (facilitator, any phase).

400.description: `invalid_duration`: start outside 1 s–99:59, or add outside 1 s–1 h

409.description: `meeting_ended`, or `no_timer` (pause, resume or add with no timer set)

delete.summary: Deletes the caller's own reflection (during Reflect).

patch.summary: Edits or moves the caller's own reflection (during Reflect).

put.summary:
Moves a card into a group, or out of its group (participants, during
Group). A group left with one card dissolves.

404.description: `reflection_not_found`, or `group_not_found` (not a group of this meeting, or dissolved)

put.summary:
Reacts to a reflection with an emoji (participants, during Discuss, on a
card of the current group). Idempotent.

200.description: The emoji on that card, with its new count and the event seq it is valid at

delete.summary: Takes back the caller's reaction (same rules as adding it). Idempotent.

200.description: The emoji on that card, with its new count and the event seq it is valid at

delete.summary: Deletes a task. Any team member may.

404.description: `task_not_found`: no such task or not a member of its team

patch.summary: Edits a task's content. Any team member may.

404.description: `task_not_found`: no such task or not a member of its team

put.summary:
Moves a task between or within columns. With neither neighbour, the task
goes to the end of the column. Any team member may move any task.

400.description: `invalid_position`: a neighbour is not in the team and target column, or is the task itself

404.description: `task_not_found`: no such task or not a member of its team

get.summary: Lists the caller's teams.

post.summary: Creates a team. The caller becomes its first admin.

get.summary: Returns one of the caller's teams.

404.description: `team_not_found`: no such team or not a member

delete.summary: Deletes a team and everything in it (admin).

post.summary:
Uploads an image for a reflection or task of the team. The image is
decoded and re-encoded as WebP: only its pixels (and frames) are kept.

requestBody.description: A PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image of at most 5 MB

get.summary: Lists a team's open invitations (any member).

post.summary:
Invites someone by email (any member). When that email already has an
open invitation, its inviter and admins get it back; other members get
`already_invited`.

201.description: The invitation and its personal link

delete.summary: Revokes an invitation (its inviter or an admin).

403.description: Neither the inviter nor an admin

get.summary: Returns the team join link (any member).

post.summary: Regenerates, enables or disables the join link (admin).

get.summary: Lists the team's meetings, newest first.

404.description: `team_not_found`: no such team or not a member

post.summary: Starts a meeting; the caller becomes its facilitator.

404.description: `team_not_found`: no such team or not a member

get.summary: Lists the members of a team, admins first.

delete.summary:
Removes a member (admin) or leaves the team (own user id). When the last
member leaves, the team is deleted.

patch.summary: Promotes or demotes a member (admin). The last admin cannot be demoted.

get.summary: Lists the team's tasks, ordered by status column and position.

parameters.name: mentioned
parameters.description: Comma-separated user ids: only tasks mentioning any of them.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Only tasks written by this user.

parameters.name: meeting
parameters.description: Only tasks attached to this meeting.

200.description: The tasks, by status then position

404.description: `team_not_found`: no such team or not a member

get.summary: A user's picture. Visible to the user and to people sharing a team with them.
get.description:
The bytes are cached as immutable under their version (spec §20), so they
are only sent when `v` is the current `pictureVersion`. Any other `v`, or
none, is redirected to the current version's URL.

200.description: The image bytes, when `v` is the current version

302.description: `v` is missing or not the current version: `Location` is the current version's URL

304.description: `If-None-Match` matches the `ETag`: the cached image is current

post.summary: Issues a short-lived ticket for the WebSocket handshake (spec §3.3).

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up.

Readiness: the database is reachable and every migration this binary knows
is applied. Migrations applied by a newer release are ignored, so pods of
the previous release stay ready during a rolling upgrade.

AttachmentDto.description: An uploaded image, converted to WebP. Rich text references it as ``.

AuthConfig.description: Which sign-in methods the sign-in page offers.

passwordResetUrl.description: Shown as "Forgot password?" when set. Retro sends no email itself.

ColumnWritingDto.description:
Reflections being written in a column: new ones, and sent ones being
edited.

CreateGroupRequest.description: A card dropped onto another card.

targetId.description: The card it was dropped onto.

content.description: Rich text (HTML); sanitized by the server.

CreateTaskRequest.description: A task for the current group.

content.description: Rich text (HTML), sanitized on the server; `@` mentions of team members.

groupId.description: The current group of the meeting.

DiscussGroupDto.description: A group in Discuss order, with its vote total.

votes.description: Votes the group got, everyone's (revealed in Discuss).

DragDto.description:
A card being dragged, and by whom (snapshot and `card.dragging`; spec
§9.3).

groups.description:
Most votes first (Discuss order). Empty when the meeting ended
during Reflect: its reflections were never revealed.

participants.description: In joining order, including people who left the team since.

tasks.description:
The tasks written in the meeting, oldest first, with their current
board status.

langCode.description: BCP 47 tag for the `lang` attribute, e.g. "it".

language.description: English name of the language, e.g. "Italian".

GroupDto.description: A group as clients see it (snapshot and events).

column.description: The column it is shown in: the one of the card it was created on.

position.description: Its place in that column, among the ungrouped cards' `position`.

index.description: Index into `order` of the person speaking now.

IcebreakerGotoRequest.description: Who the icebreaker goes back to.

userId.description: Someone who already had their turn.

InvitationDto.description: An open invitation, as listed in team settings.

url.description:
Personal accept link (`/invite/{token}`) to share with the invitee.
Only for the inviter and admins (spec §6.1); `null` for other members.

InvitationPreviewDto.description: What `/invite/{token}` shows before the invitee answers.

alreadyMember.description: The caller already belongs to the team.

members.description: Up to six members; empty unless the invitation is open.

enabled.description: Whether opening the link lets people join.

url.description: Absolute URL of the link; absent if none was ever generated.

alreadyMember.description: The caller was a member before opening the link.

invitations.description: Open invitations sent to the user's email, newest first.

signInMethod.description: `sso` when the user has a linked identity, else `password`.

teams.description: Teams the user belongs to, by name.

MeetingInviteAcceptedDto.description: Where a meeting invite link led.

joinedTeam.description: The caller was added to the team by this link.

discussGroupId.description: During Discuss, the group everyone follows.

discussOrder.description:
From Discuss on, every group in Discuss order with its vote total
(spec §9.5); empty before, so totals stay hidden until then.

drags.description: Cards being dragged right now, and by whom (Group).

groups.description: From Group on, the groups, by column and place.

myVotes.description:
From Vote on, the caller's own votes per group. Nobody sees anyone
else's votes.

onlineIds.description:
Everyone in the meeting room right now, including people whose join
is still on its way.

reactions.description:
From Discuss on, the reactions on every reflection, each emoji in the
order it was first used.

reflections.description:
During Reflect the caller's own reflections; from Group on, everyone's
(anonymous).

seq.description: Last event `seq` included in this snapshot on `meeting:{id}`.

tasks.description: From Discuss on, the tasks written in the meeting, oldest first.

oneOf.description: The countdown, if the facilitator set one.

voteBudget.description: Votes each participant may give in all (spec §9.4).

voteMaxPerGroup.description: Most votes one participant may give the same group.

votesCast.description:
During Vote, for the facilitator only: votes cast overall, as one
number (nothing per group or per person). `null` for everyone else.

writing.description: Reflections being written right now, per column.

MeetingSummaryDto.description: A meeting as the Meetings page lists it.

groupId.description: The group to move it into; `null` takes it out of its group.

afterId.description: The task the moved one should land directly after, if any.

beforeId.description:
The task the moved one should land directly before when `afterId` is
absent. With both, the task lands directly after `afterId`, and
`beforeId` must be below it.

status.description: The column to move the task to.

MyVoteDto.description: The viewer's own votes on one group.

online.description: Connected to the meeting room right now.

pictureVersion.description: Content hash of the uploaded picture; `null` when there is none.

ready.description: Pressed Ready in the current phase.

oneOf.description: Team role; `null` once they left the team.

PendingInvitationDto.description: An open invitation addressed to the signed-in user (user menu, onboarding).

PersonDto.description: A user reduced to what other team members may see next to their avatar.

pictureVersion.description: Content hash of the uploaded picture; `null` when there is none.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

ReactionAnswerDto.description:
The answer to a reaction toggle: the emoji on that card, and the meeting
event `seq` its count is valid at. A `reaction.changed` with a higher
`seq` is newer, whichever arrives first.

ReactionDto.description:
One emoji on one reflection: how many people put it there, and whether
the viewer is one of them.

mine.description: The viewer reacted with this emoji.

ReflectionCountsDto.description:
Sent reflections per column, as clients see them (snapshot and
`reflection.count_changed`).

ReflectionDto.description: A reflection, as its viewer may see it: never who wrote it.

position.description: Place in its column, set when Group starts.

version.description: Raised by every move between groups.

name.description: 0–80 characters once trimmed; empty shows as "Untitled group".

Role.description: A member's role in a team (spec §5.1).

SessionResponse.description: A new session: a short-lived access token (the refresh token is in a cookie).

userId.description: Another participant (transfer), or the caller (team admin take-over).

SummaryGroupDto.description:
A group with its vote total and its reflections. A card that was never
grouped is a group of one, with no name.

id.description: The group's id, or the card's for a card that was never grouped.

name.description: Empty when unnamed ("Untitled group", or a lone card's text).

reflections.description: By column (Plus, Delta, Ideas, Thanks), then place.

SummaryReflectionDto.description: A reflection as the summary shows it: anonymous.

groupId.description: The group of that meeting it was written for (Discuss).

position.description: Ordering key within the column; compare as plain strings.

TaskStatus.description: Where a task sits on the board (spec §9).

TeamDto.description: A team as seen by the caller.

TeamRefDto.description: A team reference: id and name only.

Timer.description: The timer as stored and as clients see it.

durationMs.description: The duration it was set to, plus the time added since.

endsAt.description: When a running countdown reaches zero (it may already have).

remainingMs.description: Time left on a paused countdown.

oneOf.description: Starts a new countdown (replacing any), 1 s to 99:59.
Adds time (1 s to 1 h); a countdown that ran out restarts from now.

TimerAction.description: What the facilitator does with the timer.

displayName.description: New display name; trimmed, 1 to 80 characters.

UpdateReflectionRequest.description: Changes to the caller's own reflection.

content.description: New rich text (HTML); sanitized by the server.
Rich text; sanitized by the server.

UserDto.description: A user as exposed by the API.

pictureVersion.description: Content hash of the uploaded picture; `null` when there is none.

VoteImpactDto.description: What lower limits would do: how many people would lose votes, never who.

affected.description: People with at least one vote the limits would remove.

VoteRequest.description: One more vote, or one fewer.

delta.description: `1` adds a vote; `-1` takes back the caller's most recent vote on the group.

voteMaxPerGroup.description: Most votes one person may give the same group.

WritingDto.description:
Reflections being written, per column, as clients see them (snapshot and
`reflection.writing`; spec §9.2).

WsTicketDto.description: A ticket to open the real-time WebSocket.
